result.question: What does the captain say to Elisha?

readings.answer: Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?
readings.support: the officer had answered the man of God | Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?

assessments.reason: The quoted reply matches v19 exactly: “Look, even if the LORD were to make windows in heaven, could this really happen?”, which is a direct expression of the key’s paraphrase “Impossible even if Yahweh opened sky.”

result.reason: Verse 7:19 directly records the captain’s skeptical statement, matching the key’s meaning.
